name: fomor
description: A local exploration assistant that reads your Trae prompts, understands what you are working on, and daily proposes alternative solution paths.

interface.shortDescription: Daily exploration of alternative solution paths based on your Trae prompts
interface.longDescription: Fomor collects the questions you send in Trae through a lightweight UserPromptSubmit hook, analyzes them daily at 03:00 with a Trae automation task, and writes a discovery report to ~/.fomor. Questions you keep asking about are promoted into long-term topics; ignored discoveries expire automatically. It never injects content into your agent session.
defaultPrompt: Set up Fomor for this workspace
Show me what Fomor explored recently
